He praised oilman Harold Hamm, whose Continental Resources has been privately owned by the Hamm family since Nov 22 2022 (SEC filings), so there is no share price. His Peterbilt story repeats his visit to the Denton, Texas plant earlier that day, which is already scored as the Oct 1 PACCAR mention, and "a colossal new natural gas power plant in Texas" names no company. None of these is scored (Trump Archive transcript).
